inlines.text: 이 페이지는 시간·사건·저장 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(ordering-replay-and-conservation-no-roll): Preserve accepted ingress order; unresolved new causality holds that event, not world. Replays no new draws/effects; atomically retain receipts/reservations/residuals/knowledge. No invented tick rate or PRNG.

blocks.text:
same-time-comparator [] independentSatisfiedProposals sorted by stored ingressOrdinal ascending
next-due [] min(valid supplied dueTicks >= worldTick); empty => NO_WORK
goal-boundary [] -100 <= W <= 100; opponent=-W; abs(W)=100 => revalidate fixed CB/beneficiary then immediate registered goal effect or registered invalidation
cutoff [] verifiedArrivalTick <= cutoffTick
receipt-count [] after receipt count = before + 1 for new committed ResultId; replay count unchanged
D18-F1 [후보·승인 전] nextDue=min(valid supplied due>=worldTick); empty=>NO_WORK; independent already-satisfied proposals preserve durable ingressOrdinal; ambiguous new causality=>held
D18-F2 [후보·승인 전] new committed receiptCount=before+1; exact replay unchanged; arrivalAt<=cutoff only approved cargo cutoff scope
D18-F3 [후보·승인 전] checkpoint binds rulesVersion,architecture,sourceRefs,all open phases,consumed,reserved,progress,residual,knowledge,draw results and accepted prefix; validate temporary candidate before replacing live state

inlines.text: D18의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

자료 소유자는 [object Object], 유지 계약은 same-time-comparator·next-due·goal-boundary·cutoff·receipt-count다. 상태 소유 경계는 project Tick/clockVersion,accepted ingress,causal graph,pending/residual/reservations,source variants,knowledge,draw addresses/cursors,receipts/checkpoint versions. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_REVISION, E_PRECISION, E_EVENT_CONFLICT
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_UNIT, E_TIME, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT, E_COMMIT, E_VERSION, E_CHECKSUM, E_TRUNCATED

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

items.text: approved supplied numeric tick half-open lifetime only, not world lifecycle owner
caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D18-existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/existing-clock-checkpoint-adapter.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
